compatibility.outcome: Remains optional; original correlation is held in private authenticated-delivery metadata.
compatibility.snapshots: Protected pending input is copied into the existing conversation field without mutating live input; same-instance exact duplicate pending copies are removed on restore.
compatibility.newAPIs: None; all new provenance/preservation helpers are internal.
compatibility.scope: Authentic delivery scope/call must match context admission; matching delivery owns the receipt if outcome conflicts. Copied/forged delivery does not authorize projection/correlation. Legacy outcome-only metadata remains supported.

coverage.limitation: Scoped percentages exclude Agent/context; their integration is covered by unit/live cases.
